answer: Sequential heartbeat proofs: every identity must post each epoch a verifiable delay function output, seeded by the last emission hash and its own key, that takes 40 minutes on one dedicated core and verifies in seconds. New identities sit in a tundra tier with zero voting weight until they hold 12 consecutive heartbeats. The haven pool pays only unbroken chains, and a public vault of past proofs lets anyone check for gaps. Sequential delay cannot be sped up with more hardware, so 500 fakes need 500 cores for 40 minutes every epoch, about 333 core-hours, paid even if never caught.
